name: design-taste-frontend
title_zh: 先审稿再动手的前端设计技能，落地页不撞模板
tagline_zh: 给 Agent 一双不画模板的眼睛：读 brief 先推断设计方向，落地页/作品集/改版都走真实设计系统。
tagline_en: Give your agent an eye for non-templated UI: reads briefs, infers direction, ships real design systems.
desc_en: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.
why_zh: 机制上把「审美判断」前置成预检关卡：先审内容结构再选视觉语言，而不是套组件库。改版强制先审计旧稿。
why_en: Turns taste into a pre-flight gate: infers direction from content before touching components; redesigns force an audit of the.
limit_zh: 只认 HTML/CSS/JS 静态前端，不接 React/Vue 工程；产物到可部署的页面为止，不含动效和交互逻辑。
limit_en: Static HTML/CSS/JS only, no React/Vue. Output ends at deployable page, no animations or logic. Design system must be named in brief, else minimal.
title_en: Frontend design skill: audit-first, no template look
